note: Replay with the writing family's runner or any headless host; each prompt runs in a fresh session in an empty directory.

cases.prompt: Entwirf einen Onboarding-Flow für ein B2B SaaS, bei dem neue Teams schnell zum ersten echten Wert kommen, inklusive Einladungen, unvollständigem Setup und Wiederaufnahme.
Create a complete user flow for a collaborative approval with several roles, conflicts, interruptions, and failure cases.
Improve this registration form. The submit button is disabled until all fields are valid. Check modern alternatives and implement the best one with accessibility and tests.
Wann soll unser Checkout-Formular Fehler anzeigen, beim Tippen oder erst beim Absenden?
Redesign the settings area of our SaaS admin console; people get lost between workspace, billing, and member permissions.
Design an interface where users can review, correct, reject, and undo AI-generated changes to their documents.
Design a distinctive website for a progressive software product. Avoid the generic AI landing page look and derive the visual direction from content and audience.
Rework a complex operations dashboard so people can spot anomalies, prioritize, and act on them.
Build a presentation on our product strategy that lets the leadership team make one concrete decision.
Zeichne ein Architekturdiagramm für unseren Event-Ingestion-Service, das neue Entwickler verstehen.
Set up design tokens and a dark theme for our component library and check the colors for contrast.
Plan five discovery interviews to understand why admins abandon our data import.
Audit this SaaS screen for UX, accessibility, interaction quality, and visual craft, and prioritize concrete improvements.
What motion and animation guidelines should our product follow, including reduced motion?
Fix the N+1 query in the orders API endpoint.
Write the email to Anna asking for her release decision by tomorrow noon.
Build this React settings page with our Tailwind components and wire the save button to the API.
Write the hero headline and subhead for our audit export launch.
Check the percentages in this weekly status update before I send it to the client.
Write an ADR for moving the job queue from BullMQ to Postgres.
Fix this flaky Playwright test that times out on CI.
